claims.statement: Headline trillion-dollar figures for AI coding are mostly future projections and value guesses, not counts of money actually earned.
Almost every forecast quietly assumes programmers will pay a giant AI model by the word for every task forever.
claims.paper_section: 1. Projections and measurements are different objects

claims.statement: When verified working code is saved and reused, repeated jobs drop toward the cost of electricity, shrinking vendor rent.
Headline outcome: $1T Forecasts Assume Zero Verified Code Reuse (Published market forecasts and economic cost model; no hardware meter attached.)

easy_read.easy_title: Why Saving Working Code Shrinks AI Costs
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about why saving working code shrinks ai costs.
Headline trillion-dollar figures for AI coding are mostly future projections and value guesses, not counts of money actually earned.
Almost every forecast quietly assumes programmers will pay a giant AI model by the word for every task forever.
When verified working code is saved and reused, repeated jobs drop toward the cost of electricity, shrinking vendor rent.
Key result: $1T Forecasts Assume Zero Verified Code Reuse.
Clear math and public price records checked every number.
